info.title: FNF: V-Slice (unofficial port)
info.author: leleletus
info.description: The real FNF V-Slice 0.8.7 on your Switch, 1:1 with the PC and mobile versions
info.details:
Grab your Joy-Cons and get funky! This is Friday Night Funkin' V-Slice 0.8.7, the same version you play today on PC and mobile, ported 1:1 to the Nintendo Switch. Every week, Weekend 1, Erect and Pico mixes, Freeplay, Character Select, the animated cutscenes with sound and HD Rumble on the hits.

BEFORE YOU PLAY

1) Open it with full memory. Hold R while you launch any game from the HOME menu and pick Friday Night Funkin' from the homebrew menu (a forwarder on your HOME menu works too). Opening it from the Album gives the game too little memory.

2) Stay online the first time. To keep things legal, this homebrew comes without the game's art and music. On first launch it downloads the official files (about 734 MB) straight from The Funkin' Crew's GitHub, checks every one of them and starts the game. Lost the connection or closed the game? It picks up right where it left off. You need about 1.1 GB free on the SD card.

No internet on the console? No problem: the screen tells you how to copy the files from a computer instead.

Worried about privacy? The download only talks to GitHub. No Nintendo servers, no account, no telemetry, and nothing about your console (serial number included) ever leaves it. DNS blockers like 90DNS are fine as long as GitHub is not blocked.

MODS

After the first launch you will find a "mods" folder in /switch/Friday-Night-Funkin/ on your SD card. Drop your V-Slice (Polymod) mods there, just like on PC. Mods are brand new on Switch, so if one does not work, let us know on GitHub. Psych Engine mods are not compatible: this is V-Slice.

Your saves live in the same folder.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

LICENCES AND CREDITS

Unofficial fan port, not affiliated with The Funkin' Crew Inc. or Nintendo. Friday Night Funkin' and its art, music and characters belong to The Funkin' Crew Inc.; the game files are downloaded from their own repository for your personal use, so please do not share them. If you love the game, support the official release!

Licences: game and port code under the Apache License 2.0. Built with FFmpeg (LGPL 2.1+), OpenAL Soft (LGPL 2.0+), SDL2 (zlib), curl (curl licence) and other devkitPro libraries under their own licences. The full source to rebuild this .nro is on GitHub.

Credits: The Funkin' Crew (Friday Night Funkin'), FunkinNXTeam for the first V-Slice Switch port this one grew from, Slushi for lime-nx and hx_libnx, devkitPro, HaxeFlixel, OpenFL and lime.

Source code: https://github.com/leleletus/Funkin

changelog:
0.8.7-nx-release-1
- Friday Night Funkin' V-Slice 0.8.7 on Switch, 1:1 with the PC and mobile versions: every week, Weekend 1, Erect and Pico mixes, Freeplay and Character Select.
- First launch downloads the official game files (about 734 MB) from The Funkin' Crew's GitHub and picks up where it left off if the connection drops.
- Animated cutscenes with sound.
- Credits screen fixed.

Open it by holding R while launching a game (or from a forwarder). Install steps, mods, licences and credits: see the README.
